summary: Wave 2 end-to-end tested: Backend (reject-handover, waitlist/notify extended body, out-of-catalog with channel) + Frontend (abandoned carts relaunch form, cash reject button/modal, waitlist notify modal, OOC Source column, catalog no-results OOC form, POS grid density). Backend: 4/4 pytest cases PASS. Frontend: all required data-testids present and interactions working. One minor observation: POS grid class is 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8 gap-2.5' which is MORE dense than the spec's 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-4' — matches the goal of being denser than the previous version but doesn't match the exact spec breakpoints. Hydration warning from PeriodSelector persists (noise, not a bug).

issues: Grid class is 'grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8' — denser than the previous version (goal achieved) but not literally 2/3/4/5 as specified. Confirm with product owner whether 2/4/8 is acceptable.
Hydration warning <span> cannot be a child of <option> from /app/frontend/src/components/shared/PeriodSelector.jsx line 96 — noise, pre-existing from iter 34.

action_items: None blocking. (Optional) Align POS grid cols with the exact spec (2/3/4/5) if required. (Optional) Clean up PeriodSelector hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code in /app/backend/server.py waitlist_notify (lines 6064-6067) — unreachable code after `return` on line 6063. Harmless but should be removed.

RelaunchOfferIn model does not include the new optional fields used by frontend (image, offer_custom, target_mode); backend accepts via Dict usage elsewhere but Pydantic model is now stale and silently drops unknown fields.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all required data-testids and flows

seed_data_creation: Created and left a waitlist entry via POST /public/waitlist. Rejected one cash-session handover for session 0572ac12-0118-4453-837c-aad88f6a079d (now status=rejected with rejection_reason). Added test out-of-catalog keyword 'test_xyz_wave2' with channel=search.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 2 fully validated. Backend endpoints: POST /api/cash-sessions/{sid}/reject-handover (400 on empty reason, 200 valid; session.status→rejected, rejection_reason recorded); POST /api/waitlist/{wid}/notify accepts body {channels, message, offer_type, offer_value, offer_custom, image, starts_at, ends_at} and inserts in db.waitlist_notifications returning {ok, notification_id}; POST /api/public/out-of-catalog accepts channel ('site'|'pos'|'search'|'console'), stored and surfaced on GET /api/out-of-catalog grouped output.
